title: The Beyond Ideas cycle
source: From Beyond Ideas — Lead to Impact
summary: Four stages that turn an idea into a venture that lasts. The last stage feeds the first: every venture keeps discovering.

stages.name: Discover
stages.line: Find the real problem, and the people who have it.

stages.name: Design
stages.line: Shape the solution and the model that will sustain it.

stages.name: Deliver
stages.line: Execute with discipline; measure what matters.

stages.name: Evolve
stages.line: Learn, adapt and build for the long term.

taught: Entrepreneurship Management at SIMSREE, the Growth Mindset Master Class (Kampala, 2026), and mentoring for founders.

title: The productivity lens
summary: A plain sequence for improving any process — taught to Indian Navy officers through Gemba, Kaizen and a Productivity War Room.

stages.name: Observe
stages.line: Go and see the work as it really happens.

stages.name: Identify
stages.line: Name the waste, the delay and the root cause.

stages.name: Eliminate
stages.line: Remove what adds no value, one step at a time.

stages.name: Progress
stages.line: Lock in the gain, then raise the bar.

taught: Productivity Management for Indian Navy gazetted officers, the Naval Dockyard MDP at SIMSREE, and process consulting through Inflection Point.
